descriptionHtml:
MSI PRO B860M-E mATX Motherboard (LGA 1851 Socket / Intel Core Ultra Processors Support / DDR5 Memory Slots / PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot / M.2 PCIe 4.0 NVMe Slot / 2.5G Ethernet LAN / HDMI & VGA Outputs / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Build a stable and efficient business or gaming system with the MSI PRO B860M-E mATX motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Engineered specifically for the latest Intel Core Ultra processors (Series 2) on the LGA 1851 socket, this motherboard combines high-speed DDR5 memory performance with ultimate hardware reliability. Featuring a PCIe 5.0 x16 expansion slot, high-speed M.2 Gen4 NVMe storage support, 2.5G Ethernet connectivity, and EZ M.2 Clip design for effortless installation, the MSI PRO B860M-E delivers exceptional productivity and seamless operation.
